Evelyn / Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We discussed a mutual action plan to get Redwood approved for a production pilot. Procurement wants a clear sequencing of security gates: SOC 2 attestation, SIG/CAIQ questionnaire completion, and a DPA signed with data retention specifics.

Quick asks from our side to build an internal timeline:
- Can you share a one-page MAP with concrete owners and dates?
- Do you have a recent SOC 2 Type II report we can review? (redacted ok)
- We need the SIG spreadsheet filled at least to the ‘controls-in-scope’ level within 10 business days.
- DPA: we have a few redlines around retention and subprocessor notification — can your legal review those?

Ideal target: pilot start 2027-06-15. Procurement asked whether that is feasible if gating is prioritized.

Thanks —
Ben Thompson

Ben —

Appreciate the clarity. I attached a one-page MAP (MAP_NVBank_v1.0.pdf) and a pre-populated SIG workbook (SIG_Assessment_v2.xlsx) with our initial responses. High level notes:

- SOC 2: Redwood has a current SOC 2 Type II (2026-10-01 to 2027-03-31). We can provide a redacted copy under an NDA; I’ve linked the control summary in the MAP.
- SIG: the workbook contains our standard responses for controls we own. Please flag the controls you’d like us to drill into; we can prioritize the privacy- and data-processing-related sections.
- DPA: I’ve CC’d Kimberly (Legal). Kimberly — we received NovaBank’s redline (DPA_redline_NovaBank.docx). Can your team run a quick feasibility check on retention windows and subprocessor notification SLA (they’re asking for 7 days)?

Proposed sequencing to meet their pilot target (high level):
1) Day 0–3: NDA / redacted SOC 2 exchange.
2) Day 1–10: SIG workbook completion + two targeted deep-dives.
3) Day 3–14: Legal reviews DPA redlines; negotiate retention (we propose our standard 90/365 window with options).
4) Day 10–21: Final signoffs + procurement PO.

We can accelerate the SIG deep-dive if NovaBank assigns control owners — that saves about a week.

I also propose a short 30-min sync on Monday to lock owners. When works for you?

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

T: +1 (650) 555-9912

Forwarding NovaBank asks — Jordan (AE) notes: procurement is time-boxed and expects a clear escalation path if legal iteration takes longer than 10 business days.

Evelyn — I can commit to owning the procurement cadence and chase the PO once legal confirms DPA carveouts. If we prioritize: SOC 2 exchange (redacted) + SIG proof points, we can usually get internal security greenlight prior to DPA completion in competitive cases — provided the DPA redlines are limited to retention and subprocessors.

Kimberly — please advise whether Redwood can accept: (a) a 30/90 retention window for logs/aggregates and 365 days for customer-provided PII (with documented archival), and (b) a 14-day subprocessor notification SLA (we cannot guarantee 7 days in all jurisdictions). If not, I’ll escalate to (Sales Ops) for approval of a limited concession.

—Jordan

Subject: Re: MAP draft + gating signals (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)

Thanks for the ping. Quick legal read and proposed position:

- DPA retention: Redwood recommends a default retention of 90 days for request/aggregate logs, 365 days for searchable metadata, and customer-designated PII retention per contract. We can offer a carveout to set a 30/365 model only with an approved business justification.
- Subprocessor notification: 14-day notice is reasonable; 7 days is operationally difficult in some clouds. We are willing to provide 7-day notice for high-risk subprocessors with SLA commitments, but standard practice remains 14 days.
- EU residency / data transfers: NovaBank did not mark EU residency constraints in the redline; if they require EU-only processing, we will need a Private/VPC deployment discussion and additional timeline (3–6 weeks).
- SOC 2 exchange: redacted report is fine; we will not disclose control testing papers.

Action items:
1) I’ll return a DPA counter-redline by EOD Monday (2027-05-17) focused narrowly on retention clauses and subprocessors.
2) Evelyn — please confirm whether logs/archives can be scoped as non-PII by default so we can propose a 365-day searchable metadata window.
3) Jordan — can you confirm whether NovaBank will accept a phased acceptance (security attestation + SIG completed before execution, DPA final within 14 days after)? That approach shortens procurement friction.

—Kimberly Park
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Appreciate the rapid responses and the MAP. Procurement reviewed the proposed sequencing and is willing to accept a phased acceptance:

- Phase A (security gate): redacted SOC 2 exchange + SIG workbook completed to in-scope level. Once accepted by our security committee, they will provision a staging environment and approve pilot access.
- Phase B (contract gate): DPA final signoff within 14 calendar days of Phase A acceptance.

We can target Phase A acceptance by 2027-05-28 if Redwood can: (a) provide the redacted SOC 2 report by EOD Tuesday (2027-05-18), and (b) complete the SIG-in-scope tab and schedule a 60-minute controls deep-dive the week of 2027-05-24. Procurement will issue a conditional PO following Phase A acceptance.

Ben
Head of Platform Security, NovaBank
